# B3 — Unsupervised segmentation of M5 and VN1 series (generated by code/segment_series.py)

Features (8): log_mean, log_size, adi, cv2, since_sale, trend_26, recent_ratio_13, peak_ratio_52. Fitted on window w52 (balanced sample, 18,000 series), applied unchanged to w26 and main.

## 3. Segment profiles (median of the raw features, window w52, both datasets pooled)

| segment   |   log_mean |   log_size |   adi |   cv2 |   since_sale |   trend_26 |   recent_ratio_13 |   peak_ratio_52 |
|:----------|-----------:|-----------:|------:|------:|-------------:|-----------:|------------------:|----------------:|
| S1        |       1.99 |       2.1  |  1.12 |  0.31 |            0 |       0    |             -0.04 |            0.85 |
| S2        |       1.13 |       1.56 |  1.74 |  0.37 |            2 |      -0.18 |             -0.54 |            0.88 |
| S3        |       0.23 |       0.85 |  5.44 |  0.16 |            5 |       0    |             -0.22 |            0.51 |

log_mean / log_size = log(1 + mean weekly sales / mean positive sale); since_sale in weeks; trend_26 and recent_ratio_13 are log ratios (0 = no change); peak_ratio_52 = log(largest week / mean positive sale, last 52 weeks).
